app.title: Sneaky Link
app.subtitle: 15 questions about desire and a casual connection

startScreen.title: Sneaky Link
description: Take turns and be direct about what you want.
Nothing shared here creates permission or obligation later.

endScreen.title: Are you awake right now?
endScreen.subtitle: Keep the desire. Lose the part that depends on pretending not to care.

questions.question: What did you expect our chemistry to feel like, and what surprised you?
What does my online version get wrong about me?
What name do you use for me in your phone, and what does it hide or reveal?
Name one new thing you would genuinely like to discuss trying. Discussion is the whole dare.
What message from me would make you want to clear your evening?
When does a late-night message feel exciting, and when does it feel careless?
What makes a place feel safe enough for desire, yours or mine?
Name one part of me you are drawn to. Ask before turning the answer into touch.
When do I enter your mind without being invited?
What part of your desire do you usually make smaller when talking about it?
What do I do well that is not only physical?
What is your honest post-midnight comfort food?
What do you like seeing me wear, and what story does it create for you?
Invent a code phrase that means: I want you, and I still want a clear yes.
Why do you return, beyond convenience and chemistry?
